text: I noticed a bright purple light over there that looked like it was right on the horizon.
We were talking about various things and I called this light to Mr. Good's attention,
knowing that he was real familiar with that area over there.
And he said, well, it's probably a light on a pumping station or a light over to a ranch.
They've been putting quite a few of those mercury vapor lights in.
I said, well, it just looked too purple to be a Mercury Vapor light to me.
And we continued driving.
It didn't stop at that time.
And I kept watching the light.
And as we traveled down the highway, there appeared to be a blue light
that just seemed to appear right out of this purple light.
We were just almost parallel with the light.
And as we drove, well, this light, the blue light, seemed to move further over to the right.
We pulled over on the right-hand side of the road and stopped and got out and looked at the light briefly.
The blue light had moved a good ways from the purple light at this time.
We made a U-turn there and stopped on the other side of the highway and got out and looked at these lights through binoculars.
At this time, the light seemed to float up in the air just a very few degrees above the horizon.
It just hanged suspended there.
So we got back in the car to drive back towards Damon to take one of the back roads
to go over towards the Salmonard River and see if we could get closer to it.
We had driven, I guess, about a half a mile back towards Damon.
We almost stopped again.
We didn't pull off the highway.
and there was no traffic on the highway, and Goode had his window down on his side,
and he observed the lights again with the binoculars,
and they seemed to still be in the same position as they were.
So he laid the binoculars down and said,
Well, you watch it, and I'll drive on back that way.
And just as we started up, he said, Are the other lights still there?
And I said, Man, they're not there. They're right here on us.
Well, the object had moved just in a blink of an eye, it seemed like, where they were to right beside the highway.
The purple light was illuminating the inside of the patrol car, ground all around us.
And here this thing was, just about looked like it wasn't any more than 100, 150 feet in the air.
It was right out the side of the highway, completely motionless.
There was a bright, almost full moon, almost directly overhead.
The moon illuminated the object.
We could see the outline very distinctly.
We could see the shadow on the ground underneath it,
and my gosh, it looked like a football field.
